tasks.description: Read: count samples by a label prefix.
tasks.prompt: How many samples in the collection {collection} have an external label that starts with '{setup.prefix}-'? Answer with the number.

tasks.description: Read: molecular formula and weight of one sample.
tasks.setup:
s = collection.new_sample_smiles('CN1C=NC2=C1C(=O)N(C(=O)N2C)C')
s.properties['external_label'] = f'{run}-caf'
s.save()
result = {'label': f'{run}-caf'}
tasks.prompt: What are the molecular formula and the molecular weight of the sample with the external label '{setup.label}' in the collection {collection}?

tasks.description: Write: create a sample from SMILES with an external label.
tasks.prompt: Create a sample of ethanol (SMILES CCO) in the collection {collection} with the external label '{run}-EtOH'.

tasks.description: Write: set the amount of an existing sample.
tasks.setup:
s = collection.new_sample_smiles('Cc1ccccc1')
s.properties['external_label'] = f'{run}-tol'
s.save()
result = {'label': f'{run}-tol', 'id': s.id}
tasks.prompt: Set the amount of the sample with the external label '{setup.label}' in the collection {collection} to 250 mg.
